title: Structured Reporting of HRCT Exams for Fungal Pneumonia (FUNG-RADS)
summary: Assessment of characteristic imaging signs of fungal pneumonia and development of a RADS scoring system for grading fungal pneumonia suspicion
conditions: Pneumonia due to other specified infectious organisms

interventions.name:
It is a retrospective, monocentric study.
Individual course of study:
1. Collection of clinical and microbiological data as well as imaging, anonymization
2. Qualitative and quantitative reporting: Quantitative and qualitative, randomized and blinded evaluation of imaging
3. Evaluation: determin
Controls are other infections which solely explain the clinical status of the patient

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Proven Fungal Pneumonia
Host factors per EORTC/MSGERC-Definition
Exclusion criteria:
Primarily extrapulmonalary fungal infection
Limitation of diagnostic interpretation by confounding diseases
